tool_args.rationale: The paid observations show increasing, concave substrate response and suppression at higher gradients. Fit a saturating substrate term with a saturating gradient-dependent siphon and a local square-root term, then test it on fresh observations. Confirmation has not yet been observed.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It has no gradient dependence, whereas the observations show a substantial gradient-associated reduction.
A single power law does not naturally represent a saturating substrate response with a bounded gradient siphon.
Nine observations now support fitting a compact smooth interaction model; the nuisance reading is irrelevant. Fresh confirmation is more informative than another probe at this stage.
